item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 13/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will persist over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The tropical cyclone over the southern part of the South China Sea will move in the general direction of the central part of Vietnam in the next couple of days. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China on Sunday. It will be windy and become cooler over the coast of southern China early to midweek next week. Besides, the area of low pressure over the western North Pacific will develop into a tropical cyclone gradually, and edge closer to the vicinity of the Luzon Strait on Sunday. However, there are uncertainties in its subsequent development and movement.
